label: control-C71
prompt:
Listen to the explicit audio and observe the synchronized silent picture. Report only gross audio facts. silent_ranges means near-total absence of sound lasting at least 2 seconds, not gaps between notes. If you cannot hear the explicit audio say so. Return ONLY JSON: {"heard_audio":boolean,"music_present":boolean,"duration_seconds":number,"silent_ranges":[{"start":number,"end":number}],"audible_description":string,"uncertainty":string}. All-zero audio may have heard_audio=false. Do not judge artistic quality.
Each named film has a silent visual stream immediately followed by its synchronized explicit audio; both start at t=0. Listen to that audio. Never infer audio from visible actions. Video sampled at 4 fps; do not claim frame-accurate sync.

judgment.audible_description: A continuous instrumental music track plays throughout the entire duration.
